newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan October jobless rate at 3.05 percent.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan October jobless rate at 3.05 percent.

text.p: Taiwan's unemployment rate was at 3.05 percent in October, a shade above September's 3.03 percent, the Directorate General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics said on Saturday.
The number of unemployed people in October increased by 1,000 to 285,000 from September, while the number of employed also rose by 1,000 to 9.068 million.
The bureau attributed the slight rise in the jobless rate to the termination of seasonal and temporary jobs.
The average unemployment period was 22 weeks, it said.
Unemployment among college graduates was at 3.64 percent in September, down from 3.93 in September and 4.19 percent in August.
